[SWS_CanSM_00653]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Can_01145, SRS_Can_01142
⌈If more than one CAN controller belongs to one CAN network and for one of its con-
trollers a bus-off is indicated with CanSM_ControllerBusOff, then the CanSM shall
stop in context of the effect E_BUS_OFF the other CAN contoller(s) of the CAN network,
too.⌋
